notes:
A formal word for structured discussion or debate, typically in institutional settings such as parliament, committees, or conferences. Composed of {討|とう} (attack, debate) and {議|ぎ} (deliberation). Implies a thorough examination of issues from multiple perspectives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {討議|とうぎ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to discuss, to deliberate
- {討議|とうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a discussion
- {討議|とうぎ}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: items for discussion, agenda
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{討議|とうぎ}: open discussion, free debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: argument, discussion — the most common word for debate, less formal
- ⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: debate — more adversarial, opposing sides argue their positions
- ⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧: deliberation — specifically examining and judging, used in parliament
- ⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧: consultation, negotiation — aims to reach agreement
